name: shrek-2-remastered-aspyr-voices-switch-2-4k
spoken: أصوات 2004 لم تتغير في Shrek 2 Remastered. هذا ما قاله منتجا اللعبة في أسباير (Aspyr). وقالت أسباير لموقع نينتيندو إفريثينغ إن اللعبة تعمل بدقة 4K مع 60 إطارًا على Switch 2 في وضع التلفاز. أما ألعاب Shrek الأخرى، فلا جديد عنها بعد.

angle.hook: the voices players remember from 2004 are untouched in Shrek 2 Remastered
angle.why_now: Aspyr's producers said it in an interview Nintendo Everything published on 15 Nov 2026, five days after launch
angle.what_it_means_here: players in the region who grew up on the 2004 game hear the same voices, and Switch 2 owners get 4K at 60 fps on the TV
angle.payoff: no word yet on other Shrek games returning; the whole gang in one closing picture

decision_log: 0 to 0.95 (headline, plate 0 to 0.95): the rainbow sky level with no character under the box (launch 44.0); the plate window shows the Shrek and Donkey screenshot, so the cover holds the game's two leads and the headline. Then Shrek running through the forest, low left, with Fiona mid-right now clear of the closed box (launch 42.75). The bridge shot (announce 25.0) was dropped: prerender read the 'Don't Feed the Fish' sign cut at the edge
2.0 to 4.2 (headline): Gingy close-up (announce 37.45), the farm with Shrek mid-frame (launch 40.5), Shrek and Donkey among chickens (announce 28.5): the 2004 cast the headline is about
4.2 to 8.9 L1 (who said it): Shrek walking to camera (announce 38.95), Gingy in the tree (launch 29.0), Shrek in the potion shop (launch 26.6)

8.9 to 12.9 card «أسباير لموقع نينتيندو إفريثينغ / دقة 4K مع 60 إطارًا / على Switch 2 في وضع التلفاز» on the shop footage (ground 26.5), no line over it; the trailer is illustration, the figure is Aspyr's (frames a second spelled out in the caption); the first note «في الثانية على Switch 2 في وضع التلفاز» was wider than the plate

12.9 to 16.95 L2 (other Shrek games): Shrek in the kitchen level (launch 45.0), Fiona dancing (announce 37.0), Donkey (announce 37.75), Shrek on the forest path (launch 30.2, ends 0.15 s before the REMASTERED GRAPHICS card), closing on the framed group picture of Donkey, Shrek, Fiona and Gingy (announce 40.6)
